title: Why Homeopathy Is Pure Nonsense | Proven Through an Experiment
description:
Why is homeopathy still popular despite being debunked by science again and again? In this special episode, we put homeopathy to the ultimate experimental test — using dangerous chemicals, serial dilutions, and the very principles homeopaths swear by. What happens when you follow the method exactly and then actually drink the so-called “medicine”? Spoiler: nothing but water.

We break down:
The myth of potentisation: why homeopaths believe more dilution = more power.
Avogadro’s limit explained: why after 12C, not a single molecule of the original substance remains.
The water memory claim: why science shows water “forgets” in femtoseconds.
The IIT Bombay nanoparticles study: why later research proved it wrong.
Placebo effect vs real science: why anecdotal “it worked for me” stories don’t equal evidence.

If you’ve searched for why homeopathy is nonsense, homeopathy debunked, homeopathy placebo effect, Avogadro’s number homeopathy, homeopathy scam, homeopathy science explained, this video gives you the rational, scientific perspective.

Homeopathy is marketed as “complementary and alternative medicine,” but in reality it’s just plain water and sugar pills sold with pseudoscientific jargon. Watch till the end to see why experiments, evidence, and critical thinking prove beyond doubt that homeopathy is a reckless fraud.

👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe if you want more myth-busting science videos that fight pseudoscience with facts.
